notes: GAAP city audit (CAFR). Governmental lines from the governmental funds Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds column (p5); fund balance 12,780,961 -> 16,564,532. debt_proceeds = Issuance of Long-Term Debt 3,200,000; other_financing = sale of capital assets 80,000 - payment to refunded bond escrow agent 3,200,000. ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet Cash and Cash Equivalents 4,094,164 (p4); ending_investments = Investments 10,155,701 (CDs 211,383 and restricted investments 122,255 also printed there), as FY2023. Business-type lines from the proprietary statement Combined Utilities column (p7); the Internal Service fund (governmental activities) is not in the governmental funds and is not recorded. Business-type disbursements total = Statement of Activities total business-type expenses 27,428,289 (p2). Capital contributions 7,927,102 in business_type.other_financing. Transfers balance across funds (2,213,746 + 267,275 = 2,084,283 + 396,738 = 2,481,021). Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), primary government only. Detail: General Fund budgetary comparison (p10); nonmajor special revenue (pp14-20), Debt Service (p21) and Capital Project Funds (pp22-23) budget schedules (budgetary basis, with budget; pp15, 17, 19, 23 are right-hand continuation pages read with the row labels of the facing pages 14, 16, 18, 22); utilities from the Combined Utilities departmental schedule (pp11-13), nonoperating items at fund level. Unlike FY2023 the trim has no nonmajor combining statement, so the South Sioux City Community Foundation fund (no budget schedule) has no detail. Lines with zero actual and zero budget are not recorded. Pages 24-29 are statistical-section tables, not recorded. Read pages 1-29 of 29
